content: "Elder Jinbaek," Han said, his baritone voice echoing off the stone. "Your southern meridian circulation shows a forty percent occlusion at the third lumbar gate. You acquired this deficiency eighty-three days ago during a failed breakthrough in the Forbidden Vault." Jinbaek turned pale. "How... how do you know this?"
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Forensic meridian diagnosis, physiological exposure.

content: "You come with stolen steel and borrowed words," Han spoke, each syllable dropping like an anvil into water. "You speak of history as if you were its author. But a thief cannot become an emperor simply by sitting upon a stolen throne. Look into my eyes, Jinbaek. Do you truly believe you will leave this peak whole?"
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Devastating moral dismantling, soul-crushing authority.

content:
Han squinted down his nose at Jinbaek, looking like a man observing a particularly unappealing worm on a dung heap.
*(Oh gods, oh Buddha, please let this work!)* Han prayed in blind panic, his stomach churning into liquid acid. *(Jin whispered this secret into my ear ten minutes ago! If this old bastard attacks me I will explode like a dry melon!)*
Outwardly, Han gave a chilling, contemptuous sigh.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: The King / Reigen perfection: internal stomach terror vs. god-tier external arrogance.
